name: Hyoutenka 30° no Zetsubou
source:
Alone with my cute kouhai... in the freezer. Beyond the pain of hypothermia, undressing, hallucinations, and other hardships lie only [b]the truth[/b] and [b]death[/b].

It's a visual novel that exposes human nature during extreme situations.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3736150]Steam[/url]]
translation:
和我可爱的小宝贝一起……在冰箱里。除了体温过低、脱衣、幻觉和其他困难的痛苦之外，只有[b]真相[/b]和[b]死亡[/b]。

这是一部揭露极端情况下人性的视觉小说。

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3736150]Steam[/url]]
